ideas.topic: The Pharaoh Who Vanished From History
ideas.hook: They tried to erase his name from every monument, but they failed.
ideas.why: This leans into the 'disgrace' and mystery narrative proven popular by mummification videos, while remaining historically grounded in the erasure of figures like Akhenaten.

ideas.topic: The Secret Sound Inside the Great Pyramid
ideas.hook: What if I told you the Great Pyramid was designed to hum?
ideas.why: It mirrors the curiosity-driven success of 'the only mummy you can hear' by focusing on sensory, mysterious physical aspects of Egyptian architecture.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Feared This Specific Serpent
ideas.hook: Before the pyramids, there was a beast that the Egyptians prayed would never wake up.
ideas.why: Capitalizes on the high-performing 'mythological serpent' trend while keeping the tone cinematic and focused on Ancient Egyptian beliefs like the chaos serpent Apophis.
